messages:
Marta: heads up — we're doing a forced base-image rebuild tomorrow 08:00 UTC to address CVE-2026-1234 in glibc. Need quick preflight: RBAC for cosign signer, KMS key rotation window, and audit logging changes. @devon can you confirm the signer service account path and who needs access? Also need a canary plan for runtime fallback if new image causes OOMs. TL;DR: cosign + KMS + audit.

devon: on it. signer SA is infra/cosign-signer@redwood. We'll need to grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner and roles/storage.objectViewer for GCR buckets. Who owns the KMS key rotation? @alexa?

alexa: I own key rotation schedule. We can schedule a short rotation at 09:00 UTC, but rotating right before cutover is risky. Suggest pre-rotating the key and creating a dedicated key version for signing; cosign supports KMS key versions via `--kms`. Example: `cosign sign --key 'gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/base-images/cryptoKeys/signer/cryptoKeyVersions/3' gcr.io/redwood/base-image:rebuilt`.

Marta: ok good. We also need RBAC in CI/GHA for the signing runner. @li can you add perms to the repo runner and gate the scope? Minimal: allow the runner to call KMS sign and fetch images for verification.

li: will open a PR to add `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` and a narrowly-scoped condition for repo=redwood/base-images-runner. Reference infra ticket INFRA-1234. Also will add a small secret rotation note.

buildbot: artifact uploaded: sha256:abc123def4567890.. signed:false

sam: from runtime side — ensure canary fleet has memory headroom. Plan: deploy `base-image:rebuilt-canary` to k8s namespace `canary` at 08:15 UTC, traffic weight 5%. If OOM rate > 1% for >10m or error rate >2% open incident and roll back. I'll add alert rule: alert:ImageCanaryOOM rate() > 0.01 for 10m.

Marta: audit logging — we need to surface cosign signing events to Splunk/central audit. Does cosign emit structured provenance? We should persist the signature provenance + KMS key version used. Any suggestions for a lightweight sink?

devon: cosign outputs a provenance JSON if you use `-o`/`--output`. I recommend a wrapper step: `cosign sign ... && cosign verify --output cosign-provenance.json <image> && curl -X POST "$AUDIT_SINK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @cosign-provenance.json`. Push to ops-logs or pubsub-to-splunk ingestion. That preserves KMS key metadata and signature.

li: Splunk index `images.audit` retention is 90d and has room for a few thousand events/day. I'll add the source type mapping and include a `correlation_id` with the build ID to link to CI logs.

Marta: incident response note — if after rollout we see a new CVE or runtime regression: hotpatch -> rebuild -> sign with pre-existing key version -> immediate canary -> rollback on alerts. Important: keep previous key version available for verification; don't destroy old key versions until after verification windows.

alexa: confirmed. I will not change the primary key during cutover. I'll create `signing-key-v2` and pre-generate version 1/2; we'll use version 3 for this rollout but keep v1/v2 around.

devon: PRs incoming: 1) IAM role change for runner, 2) cosign wrapper + audit post, 3) k8s canary manifests + alert rules. ETA ~4h for PRs and review.

Marta: owners: @alexa KMS, @li audit/splunk & CI perms, @devon signer & infra PRs, @sam runtime canary/alerts. I'll add a short runbook to #incidents and attach it to the PRs. Please ack if you see any gaps. :thumbsup:

buildbot: signed:true signature: MEUCIQDy... (cosign signature blob).
